data.description:
## Goal

Generalise the Game Selector lock computation so launcher lock state and in-game DLC checks consume the same unlock state, for game and DLC targets.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `src/ui/steam-lock.ts` is generalised to consume follow status plus action-reward status for game targets and exposes a DLC-target check; no-catalog/browser mode locks nothing so the web build stays fully playable.
- The Game Selector renders locked/unlocked consistently with the in-game DLC check for the same target — one source of truth.
- Unit tests cover game lock/unlock, a DLC target, the unavailable case, and the no-catalog browser no-op; the existing steam-lock tests still pass and all pass under `--project unit`.

## Minimal Implementation

- Generalise `src/ui/steam-lock.ts` (pure) to take the unified unlock state and evaluate game + DLC targets.
- Wire it where the selector builds its game list (or keep the pure computation and assert consistency in tests).

## Key Files

- `src/ui/steam-lock.ts` — generalised lock computation.
- `src/ui/GameSelectorScene.ts` — consumes locks for game entries.
- `tests/ui/steam-lock.test.ts` — extended.
- `src/ui/content-unlock-client.ts` — read source for the generalised state.

## Deliverables

Generalised lock computation + tests.

## Dependencies

- Action-reward config and drift validator (F4).
- Generalised IPC/preload bridge and total read API (F5).

## Test Plan

`npx vitest run --project unit tests/ui/`
